text:
Type: round side table with lower shelf
Use: holding a lamp, books or drinks beside a seat; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: untreated solid pine with visible knots
Colors: light natural pine
Shape: round top, smaller round shelf near the floor, four straight square legs joined by cross stretchers, compact and sturdy
Feel: natural, cozy, simple, warm
Goes with: light wood, white or cream walls, wool and linen textiles; cabins, cottages or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: NORNS
product.description: Untreated solid pine is a durable natural material that can be painted, oiled or stained according to preference.
